# 2 Kings 22 — Disagreement Log
**Chapter:** 2 Kings 22 (20 verses)
**Arbiter:** SOPHIA
**Total disagreements logged:** 4

---

## V.2 — "walked in all the way" vs. "followed the example"
- **EMET/LOGOS:** "walked in all the way of David" / **PNEUMA:** "followed the example of his ancestor David"
- **SOPHIA ruling:** "walked in all the way of David" — preserves the Deuteronomistic *halakh be-derekh* metaphor.

---

## V.11 — "tore his garments" vs. "tore his robes in anguish"
- **EMET/LOGOS:** "tore his garments" / **PNEUMA:** "tore his robes in anguish"
- **SOPHIA ruling:** "tore his garments" — the action itself communicates the emotion without editorial addition.

---

## V.16 — "evil" vs. "disaster"
- **EMET/LOGOS:** "evil" / **PNEUMA:** "disaster"
- **SOPHIA ruling:** "disaster" — *ra'ah* here means calamity, not moral evil. "Disaster" avoids misattributing moral evil to God.

---

## V.19 — "tender" vs. "responsive"
- **EMET/LOGOS:** "tender" / **PNEUMA:** "responsive"
- **SOPHIA ruling:** "tender" — *rakh* literally means soft/tender; the heart metaphor should be preserved.

---
*— SOPHIA*
